verdict.rationale: Codex CLI explicitly supports adding local/remote MCP servers via `codex mcp add`, inspecting available tools before use, and viewing active servers via `/mcp`; this configuration is shared across ChatGPT desktop app, CLI, and IDE extension. Docs also describe using MCP to connect to third-party tools like browsers or Figma. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of MCP tool usage in a real session beyond first-party docs.
